title: Corporate Flight Bookings
description: Calculate total flight bookings for n flights given multiple booking ranges [first, last, seats].
pseudocode:
1. diff = new Array(n + 2).fill(0)
2. for [first, last, seats] of bookings:
3.   diff[first] += seats
4.   diff[last + 1] -= seats
5. res = [], current = 0
6. for i = 1 to n:
7.   current += diff[i]
8.   res.push(current)

steps.note: Initialize difference array of size n+2 (n=3 here).
Apply first booking [1, 2, 10]: add 10 to index 1.
Apply first booking [1, 2, 10]: subtract 10 from index 3.
Apply second booking [2, 3, 5]: add 5 to index 2.
Apply second booking [2, 3, 5]: subtract 5 from index 4.
